🚀 ultimate-file-manager-pro | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing files efficiently across multiple platforms (Android mobile, Android TV, Windows PC) using a dual-pane interface, with advanced features for network and remote access.
✨ Key Features: • Dual-pane file management • Support for Android Mobile, Android TV/Fire TV, and Windows PC • LAN auto-discovery • Remote PC pairing • Multi-protocol network storage access
📖 Summary: Ultimate File Manager Pro is a high-performance, dual-pane file manager for Android Mobile, Android TV, and Windows PC. It focuses on privacy, efficiency, and speed, enabling seamless side-by-side file operations, LAN discovery, remote PC pairing, and multi-protocol network storage access.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 cursor-smith | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users of Obsidian with advanced and highly customizable text cursor styles and animations, enhancing the visual appeal and user experience of the writing environment.
✨ Key Features: • Extensive cursor styling (box, line, underline, solid, hollow, gradients, thickness, opacity, glow) • Customizable blinking animations (speed, balance, fade, breathing) • Smooth cursor gliding animation with speed-based responsiveness
📖 Summary: Cursor-Smith is a highly customizable cursor engine for Obsidian, allowing users to personalize their text caret with various styles, colors, and animations. It offers a wide array of effects and options to enhance the writing experience for users who desire a more visually engaging or functional cursor.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 google-play-scraper | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Scraping Google Play Store data for market research, ASO, competitor tracking, and review monitoring.
✨ Key Features: • Scrape app details, search results, top charts, developer pages, similar apps, user reviews, permissions, and data safety. • Fully typed results with runtime validation using Zod schemas. • Runs on native Node.js fetch (no external HTTP dependency).
📖 Summary: This Node.js library provides a fully typed TypeScript API to scrape data from the Google Play Store. It allows developers to fetch app details, search results, reviews, and more, serving as a modern, robust alternative to older scrapers.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 tui-use | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Allowing AI agents to interact with and control terminal-based applications (REPLs, debuggers, TUI apps) that require human input.
✨ Key Features: • Full VT Rendering: Processes PTY output accurately, including ANSI escape sequences, for clean plain text screen content. • Smart Wait: Debounces screen updates to detect stability and can wait for specific text patterns, eliminating guesswork for AI agents.
📖 Summary: tui-use enables AI agents to interact with terminal-based programs like REPLs, debuggers, and TUI applications, which are typically inaccessible to automated scripts. It provides a way to send keystrokes and read the screen output as plain text, bridging the gap between human-interactive programs and AI agents.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 musicat | Svelte
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing and enhancing a local music library with a modern, feature-rich desktop application.
✨ Key Features: • Supports MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC, OGG • Linked library using original files • Gapless playback (same sample rate) • Metadata tagger (ID3v2, Vorbis) • Auto-watch and re-scan folders
📖 Summary: Musicat is a sleek, cross-platform desktop music player and tagger built with Svelte and Tauri, designed for managing local music libraries. It offers features like gapless playback, smart playlists, metadata editing, album art fetching, lyrics retrieval, and unique visualizations like waveform and map views.
